title: Wings live: Royal Court Theatre, Liverpool | 1979
content:
Wings performed at the Royal Court Theatre in Liverpool, England, on 23 November 1979.

It was the opening night of the 19-date Wings UK Tour 1979, and the first of four consecutive nights in Liverpool. This show was a benefit for the Liverpool Institute High School for Boys, Paul McCartney’s old school. It was seen by an invited audience of 1,500, including 600 pupils from the school.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Laurence Juber on guitar; and Steve Holley on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.
